notes: This is the "+1 speed" family with strength as the number: train at a rack, break a barrier when you have the right amount of strength, buy pets that boost training, move to a harder world. That makes it Simulation on tier-ladder with the Stat Grinder preset, and Action is named second only because the boss goons and each world's final boss are the borrowed activity — letting the combat lead would import a route this layout never needed, so it stays P0. The ten worlds become ten walled tiers of the same ladder rather than ten maps, which the answers support by keeping every world a compact, walkable, realistic gym floor with no separate themes; spawner-npc comes from Action for the boss goons, and social-hub is the pet and upgrade storefront the money loop needs. Dropped the preset's trigger-rebirth because the prompt's multipliers come from reaching new stages rather than from resetting progress, and with no user to ask I took the tenth world's final boss as the end of the run.
